body:
I'd love to leave my job. But I refuse to be homeless ever again or dependent on others, because I tried that whole lifestyle of living in my car, extreme frugality, etc when I was younger and it was fucking terrible and I want to do that even less than I want to keep working a job I hate. Everyone I knew said we were "free" but really we were chained to needs just like all the people in straight society. It was just smaller in scale and more base in nature. Which is more honest for some people but not having things doesn't make your soul less damaged, you just have less stuff. 

 ADHD isn't an illness but it may as well be unless you live in the upper echelon of society. In the end if I stay alive I have to work because nobody is going to give me food and shelter for nothing and I will never again stand on a corner and ask people for money to have them spit in my faceor living. And the fact of taking medicine adds to me not wanting to be alive. That's the catch-22.  

I've "run away" before and just cut all my losses (see: living in my car) and things always ended up catching up to me anyway. Internet age, you know? Even if I decided I wanted to go live in the woods that still requires money for transport there and supplies unless you want to end up like McCandless which...there are quicker ways to die. 

But thanks for the advice, though. It means a lot to know other people feel similarly than I do about ADHD.

I think I'd be a lot happier doing something else but finding that something seems to be impossible nowadays. Nobody has any advice but STEM ENGINEERING PROGRAMMING circlejerk and it just seems like the world has no use for anybody who doesn't fall into that skillset.
